s8.headline: AI-native ≠ fundamentals-free.

columns.chip: The S10 bug was a fundamentals bug: token audience.

s8.quote: We need to teach abstraction, decomposition, and specification not just as pre-coding steps, but as the new coding.
s8.quoteBy: Thomas Dohmke, then CEO of GitHub, Aug 2025

s9.headline: Concepts outlive tools.
s9.last: Frameworks change. Engineering principles travel with you.

s10.headline: Learn with AI — and without it.
s10.trial: Anthropic randomised trial · Jan 2026 · 52 mostly junior engineers
s10.patterns: Asked AI to explain: ≥65% · Delegated to AI: <40%
s10.dora: DORA, Mar 2026: the ‘expertise paradox’ — AI can bypass the hands-on struggle that builds deep skill.
s10.gregg: “That struggle is the part where the learning happens.” — Chris Gregg, Stanford
s10.last: Use AI to accelerate learning — not to skip learning.
